members.show: Raise a toast and get a handle back. `durationMs` is counted from the moment the toast becomes VISIBLE, not from the call, so one queued behind the cap keeps its full time on screen; `0` and any negative never expire. A `loading` toast and one carrying an `action` are forced to 0 — that button is the only way to take the action.
members.dismissAll: Dismiss every visible toast and drop the queue behind them.

members.items: The current trail. `<ds-breadcrumbs>` reads this whenever no `[items]` input is bound.
members.push: Append one item to the end of the trail.
members.pop: Drop the last item. A no-op on an empty trail.
members.replaceLast: Swap the last item, or set the trail to this one item if it is empty — for a page whose leaf name arrives after its data loads.

members.lock: Take a lock. The first one saves the current `body` overflow and hides it.
members.unlock: Release a lock. Only the last one restores the saved overflow, so closing one overlay cannot re-enable page scroll under another still open above it.

members.pathChanged: Emits the new path on every navigation that lands on a DIFFERENT path — query and hash are stripped, repeats are dropped, and a navigation the app marked `dsSamePage` is skipped entirely.

members.scrollToTop: Send the layout's content region back to the top. For a screen that wants the top after its own filter or sort change, which `resetScroll="path"` deliberately does not do.
